verdict.rationale: ZCode is an AI coding workbench, so configuring cloud execution environments is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack does not document any cloud environment or way to declare repository dependencies and setup steps. The evidence covers local install, a web UI on a local workspace, SSH/WSL remote projects, and env vars for provider config and data directories; none of these is a reproducible cloud environment, and the community reports about workspace uploads are off-topic.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure a reproducible cloud environment with the dependencies and setup steps my repository needs
